cart.items: {count, plural, =0 {Your cart is empty} one {# item in your cart} other {# items in your cart}}

docs.read_more: Read the <link>Comvi documentation</link> to go further.

about.body: This is a second page, translated like the first.

fallback.only_en: This sentence is missing from the Ukrainian catalog.

demo.intro: Every string on this page comes from a translation catalog. Switch the language and watch each feature react.

switcher.title: Switch the language
switcher.body: One call re-renders every translated element, and the choice is remembered for your next visit.

interpolation.title: Parameters
interpolation.body: A value drops in where the translator put the placeholder, so the word order stays the translator's call.
interpolation.label: Your name

plural.title: Plurals that know the language
plural.body: ICU plural rules: English has one and other, Ukrainian one, few and many. Change the count and compare.

tags.title: Markup inside a translation
tags.body: The catalog wraps the words in a link tag. The translator chooses where the link sits in the sentence; your app decides what it points to and how it renders.

formatting.title: Dates and numbers
formatting.body: Intl formats follow the locale: thousands separators, month names and the date order.

lazy.title: Load translations on demand
lazy.body: The selected language and its English fallback load first. Another language loads when you select it, and the account namespace when its page opens.
lazy.namespaces: Namespaces active for every fetched locale: {namespaces}

fallback.title: Fallbacks and missing keys
fallback.body: A key missing in Ukrainian falls back to English. A key missing everywhere shows its name, so you notice it in development.

missing.title: A missing parameter stays visible
missing.body: The placeholder remains in the text instead of disappearing silently.

navigation.title: A second page, the same locale
navigation.body: The locale survives navigation, and the account namespace loads on demand.

select.title: Select by a value
select.body: ICU select picks a whole sentence by a value, here the reviewer's gender. In English only the pronoun changes; switch to Ukrainian and the verb ending changes too. The app passes one value, the translator writes each variant.
select.message: {gender, select, female {She replied to your review} male {He replied to your review} other {They replied to your review}}

ordinal.title: Ordinals
ordinal.body: selectordinal knows that English says 1st, 2nd, 3rd and Ukrainian does not. The number is the counter above, rendered as an ordinal.
ordinal.message: You are the {n, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} visitor today.

rtl.body: Arabic turns the whole page right-to-left: <html dir> follows the locale.

options.title: Call options
options.body: One call can read another locale or namespace. The names below render each language in its own language; switch languages to grow the list.
options.name: English

typed.title: Typed keys
typed.body: The keys are generated from these JSON files: a misspelled key or a missing parameter is a compile error. Open src/i18n in the editor and try it.

errors.title: Every failure reaches a hook
errors.body: t() never throws. A key that no catalog has is reported to onMissingKey, wired here to a counter you could send to your tracker. A catalog that fails to load is reported to onError, which this page does not show.

formality.title: Formal or informal
formality.body: English has one way to address someone; German has Sie and du, Ukrainian Ви and ти. One select value lets each translator pick the register, and the English stays a single sentence.
formality.message: {formality, select, formal {Welcome back. Your seat is saved.} other {Welcome back. Your seat is saved.}}
